walkthrough: Goal: V大's weeks 3 and 4 assignment, 几何体 + 点定位 概括单体: an object copied by simplifying it into its box, the box found first, then big to small, every point with a reason; then the object's exact visible edges over my drawing, never a score.

Entry: in the gallery the Today card's options button (Practice options). The Practice section now has a fourth row, Stage 4 · Simplifying with Start a session at its right, and under it one tile, Objects: a low block with a post standing on it, in pencil while never compared. The section scrolls to it.

Objects: a drill of three objects on a sheet of its own; its How shows first. Title: An object simplified into boxes; Weeks 3 and 4 · an object simplified into boxes beside its picture: the box first, then big to small, every point found by a reason. The example plays at a hand's pace beside its picture (a box with a slope cut down its far end and a notch out of its near corner, seen from above and lit from one side; its own fixed seed, never an exercise's): the box's nine other edges in pencil; the slope's points found by a face's diagonal and the thirds and heights measured on the near upright, its construction dark while it is found; then the notch's the same way, the slope's construction gone faint and the notch's dark; the visible edges in ink; then Compare: the visible edges in see-through red, what was drawn in blue dashes, the construction faint under them. Cropped at 100 % the card's example reads: the step being found dark, the steps before faint. Steps: 1 Complete the box with Sketch, 2 The biggest cut first: its points by halves and thirds, 3 Then the smaller part; a round one's square and ellipse, 4 The visible edges with Draw, 5 Compare. One paragraph says to find each point on the box's surface or inside it, never in the air, no details, and what red, blue, dashed and the rings mean. Got it.

The exercise: the left frame holds the object's picture, a solid lit from one side on the paper, the top lightest, the sides two values, the post shaded round; no lines, no horizon. My frame holds the horizon (labelled) and the box's front corner with its three edges in ink, at the picture's angle. The tools: Sketch, Draw, Undo, Redo. Next: the second object, a box with a slope cut along its top front edge, seen from below.

I complete its box with Sketch (the nine other edges), then with Draw its visible edges, but I put the cut a little too high on the front face (a mistake): the cut's lower line and its two slanted edges, and the two uprights up to it.

Compare: the object's visible edges in red as thick as my pen and see-through; my edges read in blue dashes on them, the cut's three a little above the red. The left frame now shows over the picture the whole box in pencil (its hidden edges dashed) and V大's construction in dashed pencil, the corners it finds ringed. The card is its title only. The pen is blue (Correct): I draw the cut's lower line, its two slanted edges and the two uprights again on the red and Compare: my correction is read in place of my first try, the blue on the red. The record keeps my first error (the lines' mean distance from the object, a share of the box) for later; no number shows. Undo and Redo as any stroke.

Next: the third object, a box with its top drawn in (方台). Finish: Objects drill done, beside nothing before. One more: the next drill, its How first; Got it: a cone standing on a block, Next: a block with a block taken out, Next: a box cut along its top edge. Six objects, each the same per seed.

Back in the options, Objects is in ink: compared.
